violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Observed employee washing dishes submerge dishware in quaternary ammonia for <5 seconds.
violations.corrective_action: CFM instructed employee to submerge dishware in quaternary ammonia for at least 60 seconds, following manufacturer instructions.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee cooking food and then grab a broom to sweep the floor without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS and manager instructed employee to wash hands. MCDONALD'S #18702 (Inspection Date: 03/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw beef patties stored over raw eggs in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). Employee rearranged order to have raw beef patties on the bottom shelf.

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Microwave
violations.observation: The following food item was not reheated for hot holding in the microwave oven to a sufficient temperature and/or time: observed breakfast burritos reheated in the microwave to 119F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is reheated in a microwave oven for hot holding shall be reheated so that all parts of the food reach a minimum temperature of 165F and the food is rotated or stirred, covered and allowed to stand for 2 minutes after reheating. Employee returned burritos to microwave. Burritos observed at 173F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: milk in sureshot dispenser observed at 51F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Milk discarded.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): sliced cheese, sliced tomato, shredded lettuce, breakfast sauce.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS provided written procedures for items during the inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored in chlorine sanitizer solution at 10ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Employee remade wiping cloth buckets, observed at 100ppm.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Sureshot dispenser observed at 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Milk removed from sureshot.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: ice cream machine observed with a leak and door unable to close, spray nozzle cap at griddle observed off and in poor repair.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: McFlurry spinner observed with debris, ice cream machine observed with leak and crumbs, slushie machine observed with debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean equipment.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED SPLITTER INSTALLED ON MOP SINK FAUCET.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED APPROVED SPLITTER PART NUMBER TO CFM. CFM TO PASS INFORMATION ALONG TO SUPERVISOR/OWNER FOR PURCHASE. PLEASE PROVIDE PROOF OF PURCHASE TO EHS WITHIN 3 DAYS. PROVIDE PROOF OF INSTALLATION UPON RECEIPT.
